summary: Runs the same model weights on a faster inference configuration for up to 2.5x higher output tokens per second, at premium pricing ($10/MTok input, $50/MTok output).
combines: Supported on: Research preview, beta header `fast-mode-2026-02-01`, access gated by account. claude-opus-5 and claude-opus-4-8 only, on the Claude API (including Managed Agents). Requests with `speed: "fast"` to claude-opus-4-7 return an error with no fallback. Requests to claude-opus-4-6 do not error: they silently run at standard speed, bill at standard rates, and report `usage.speed: "standard"`. Not available on Amazon Bedrock, Claude Platform on AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Foundry.
The gain is in output tokens per second, not time to first token, so it shows up most when streaming.
Switching between fast and standard invalidates the prompt cache; the two do not share cached prefixes.
Not available with the Batch API or with a Priority Tier commitment.
Fast mode has its own rate limits and its own `anthropic-fast-*-tokens-*` response headers; exceeding them returns 429 with `retry-after`.
Per-model: Opus 5 and Opus 4.8 only, and account-gated even there.
